summary: QXO, Inc. files an 8-K reporting early tender results for its subsidiary Titanium MergerCo's tender offers and consent solicitations on TopBuild Corp.'s 4.125% Senior Notes due 2032 ($500M outstanding) and 5.625% Senior Notes due 2034 ($750M outstanding). Approximately 99.54% of 2032 Notes and 99.72% of 2034 Notes were validly tendered by the June 11, 2026 early tender deadline. Notes are accepted at $1,011.25 per $1,000 principal plus accrued interest. The offers are in connection with QXO's pending acquisition of TopBuild; required consents obtained to amend indentures. Watch for closing of the TopBuild acquisition and any regulatory timeline.
